problem_statement:
Merge test cases for new CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE privilege model

The new privilege logic for CREATE TEMPORARY TABLES was merged into 10.0, but the test cases aren't there. There seem to be pieces in several test files, I checked grant2.test which contains a fragment for bug 27480 in MySQL 5.6.10, but not in 10.0.4 candidate.

http://bugs.mysql.com/bug.php?id=27480
